h1: Solution Focused Therapy in Memphis, TN
meta_description: Learn how solution focused therapy works for Memphis adults. Hicks Consulting offers virtual therapy and coaching for burnout, anxiety, and life transitions.
direct_answer: Solution focused therapy is a goal-oriented approach to mental health that emphasizes your strengths and future possibilities rather than past problems. It is a collaborative process where the focus remains on identifying small, manageable steps toward the life you want to lead. This method is often used for managing stress, burnout, and relationship strain.

sections.heading: How does solution focused therapy work for Memphis adults?
paragraphs: Solution focused therapy operates on the idea that you already possess the tools needed for change. Instead of spending long periods analyzing past traumas, this approach looks at what is working in your life right now. It asks how your life would look if the current problem were solved. This can be helpful for Black women in Memphis balancing the demands of career, family, and community. Whether you are navigating traffic on Poplar Avenue or managing a busy household in Whitehaven or Cordova, this method respects your time. It focuses on practical shifts in perspective.

Reading this information is not therapy. If you are in a crisis, please call or text 988 immediately. Hicks Consulting provides virtual individual therapy for adults located in Tennessee. There are no office visits or in-person sessions. This virtual format allows you to engage in sessions from the comfort of your home or private space. It removes the need to commute through Midtown or Germantown. The focus remains on your goals and the specific steps you can take to reach them.

sections.heading: Is this approach right for burnout and life transitions?
paragraphs: Burnout often feels like a heavy weight that makes daily tasks seem impossible. Life transitions, such as a new job or a change in relationship status, can also cause significant strain. A solution-focused approach helps by breaking down these large stressors into smaller parts. You look for 'exceptions'—times when the problem was not present or was less intense. This helps identify what you did differently during those times. It is a grounded way to address anxiety without feeling overwhelmed by the history of the issue.

Hicks Consulting also offers virtual coaching, which is a non-clinical service. Coaching is different from therapy and does not treat mental health conditions. It is another way to focus on specific life goals or professional development. For employers in the Memphis area, organizational mental health training and speaking are available. These services help workplaces understand how to support their teams. All services are provided online to residents across Tennessee, including those in Bartlett and Collierville.

sections.heading: What can I expect during a virtual session?
paragraphs: Virtual therapy sessions are conducted through a secure video platform. You should be in a private, quiet location within the state of Tennessee during the call. The conversation is centered on your current needs and future hopes. If you prefer a Christian, faith-integrated approach, this can be included in your therapy or coaching. This is only done when you request it and is never imposed. It allows you to bring your whole self, including your faith, into the room if that is important to you.

The structure of these sessions is designed to be clear and direct. You might discuss your vision for the next week or month. You might identify one small action that aligns with that vision. This approach is about building momentum. It is not about finding a quick fix but about recognizing your own agency. The goal is to help you see the resources you already have available to you.
bullets: Focus on your strengths and existing resources.
Identify small, actionable steps for change.
Look for exceptions to the problems you face.
Set clear goals for your future well-being.
Incorporate faith-integrated perspectives if you choose.

sections.heading: Where can I find local support in Memphis?
paragraphs: While Hicks Consulting provides virtual services, local resources are available for those in immediate need. Memphis and Shelby County have specific organizations dedicated to crisis intervention and community support. Knowing where to turn for help is an important part of maintaining mental health. These resources provide a safety net for the community near landmarks like the Liberty Bowl or the Mississippi River parks.

If you are looking for more information on mental health topics, you may also read about an Anxiety Therapist Serving Memphis, TN, or explore How Online Therapy Works in Memphis. For those interested in spiritual integration, the page on Christian Therapy in Memphis: Faith’s Role provides more detail. Remember that these pages are for educational purposes only and do not replace professional clinical care.

faq.q: What is the difference between therapy and coaching?
faq.a: Therapy is a clinical service designed to treat mental health conditions and address emotional distress. Coaching is a non-clinical service focused on specific life goals, performance, or transitions. Hicks Consulting offers both as separate virtual services for adults in Tennessee.

faq.q: Can I include my faith in my sessions?
faq.a: Yes. A Christian, faith-integrated approach can be used in therapy or coaching if you prefer it. This is never forced on any client. It is an option for those who want their spiritual beliefs to be part of their growth process.

faq.q: Do I need to go to an office in Memphis?
faq.a: No. All services at Hicks Consulting are virtual. There is no physical office for visits. You must be located in the state of Tennessee at the time of your appointment to receive therapy services.

faq.q: What should I do if I am in a mental health crisis?
faq.a: If you are in a crisis or experiencing an emergency, please call or text 988 to reach the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline. You can also contact the Tennessee Statewide Crisis Line or go to the nearest emergency room.

facts.claim: The 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline provides 24/7, free and confidential support for people in distress.
The Tennessee Department of Mental Health and Substance Abuse Services offers a statewide crisis line for residents.
facts.source_name: Tennessee Department of Mental Health and Substance Abuse Services

facts.claim: Solution-focused brief therapy is a future-oriented, goal-directed approach to solving human problems.
